name: Classic 4-minute
summary: The simple everyday press: coarse grind, four minutes, a gentle plunge.

steps.title: Warm the press
steps.instruction: Rinse the press with hot water, then pour it out.
steps.why: A warm carafe keeps the brew temperature steady while it steeps.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.instruction: Add the grounds, pour twice their weight in water and stir lightly.
steps.why: Wetting all the coffee at once lets the trapped CO2 escape so extraction is even.

steps.title: Steep
steps.instruction: Pour in the rest of the water, put the lid on without plunging and wait.
steps.why: Four minutes in total is long enough for body and sweetness before bitterness builds.

steps.title: Plunge and pour
steps.instruction: Press down slowly and steadily, then pour all the coffee out at once.
steps.why: Pouring it all out stops extraction; coffee left on the grounds turns bitter.

sources.title: Volcanica Coffee: French press technique, 3 recipes tested
